title: Integrated two-point hypercontractive inequality
caveat: The conclusion (including the definition of ρ and the inequality itself) is elided as `sorry` in the formal statement, so it cannot be verified against ground truth. The hypotheses (1 ≤ p ≤ q ≤ 2, b ∈ [0,1]) are taken directly from the Lean binders; the displayed inequality and the value ρ = √((p-1)/(q-1)) are reconstructed from the `current` hint, which matches the standard integrated two-point inequality used in hypercontractivity theory but is not confirmed by the snippet.
